construction: Own provider and its exact host callback scope without invoking either
first_observation: ClientSession retains the scope before awaiting actual provider identity observation, including failed or cancelled attachment
identity: First successful key is frozen; identity drift is latched until explicit replacement, even if the original key returns
capabilities: Method observations may change for the same key; cached values grant no command, stock, replay or qualification authority
close: Quiesce host dispatch and unblock pending identity observations safely
Release owned provider and callback roots outside bookkeeping locks
lifecycle_owner: Existing execution Session coordinator; no second engine, hidden runtime or Drop completion claim
host_contract: Callback quiesce/close must own actual platform dispatch, retain partial progress and handle callbacks whose Rust observer was dropped
browser: Local Rc handles and futures; compile checks do not qualify browser runtime behavior
remaining: Actual NativeConfig Client resource opening and attachment composition
Authenticated workspace and captured command context
composed_quiesce: Quiesce leaves callback roots owned; ClientSession drains its admitted attachment work and disconnects transports before final signer close/disposal.
